tagline: Low-poly triangle wallpapers. The seed lives in the file. One invite shares it.
description:
trianglify.io needs a tab on the internet, and a paid download for a high-res file. This is a GIF on your Home Screen: it works on a plane, the last palette and seed stay in the file so close-and-come-back is the same wallpaper, and a friend who opens your invite is looking at the same one — roll a new seed, they get the roll.

Pick a palette, type a seed (or roll one), drag how chunky the triangles are. Download a PNG or SVG at wallpaper size, no account.

An unofficial port of Trianglify by Quinn Rohlf, GPL-3.0. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
